_schema_notes.pack_id: slug for the pack; not used in file paths
_schema_notes.intro: OPTIONAL one paragraph on the tier picker
_schema_notes.out_dir: OPTIONAL output folder relative to this manifest (default: the manifest's own folder); tree_index.py reads it too, so prefer it over --out
_schema_notes.back_link: OPTIONAL {href, label} relative to the output folder - set it when this pack is itself a drill-down of a parent abstraction
_schema_notes.audiences[].id: lower-kebab-case; becomes the tier's output folder
_schema_notes.audiences[].label: depth or purpose of the tier - never a job title or a client
_schema_notes.audiences[].example_role: OPTIONAL illustration only ('for example: a tester'), never the tier's identity
_schema_notes.audiences[].intro: OPTIONAL one paragraph above that tier's flowchart
_schema_notes.nodes[].id: lower-kebab-case, stable: renaming it breaks every link into its pages
_schema_notes.nodes[].label / sublabel: box text; the box grows to fit it - there are no pixel fields
_schema_notes.nodes[].row: 0-based level, top to bottom; boxes of a row are laid out left to right in list order and centred. Put non-branching steps side by side on one row; give a row of its own only to a fan-out/fan-in point
_schema_notes.nodes[].edges_to: ids this box flows into; same-row targets get a horizontal connector
_schema_notes.nodes[].audience.<tier>.status: available | draft | pending | pointer | redirect | pdf | deferred | missing | stale - the fixed vocabulary; anything else is an error
_schema_notes.nodes[].audience.<tier>.source_md: path (relative to this manifest) of the raw, validated source of record - preferred over body; rendered, never copied
_schema_notes.nodes[].audience.<tier>.body: short markdown for a tier that needs another depth than the raw source; ignored when source_md is set
_schema_notes.nodes[].audience.<tier>.placeholder_kind: not_available | confidential | diagram_only - used when there is neither source_md nor body
_schema_notes.nodes[].audience.<tier>.pending: OPTIONAL list: what exactly is still missing (shown as badges); empty it when nothing is
_schema_notes.nodes[].audience.<tier>.drills_into: OPTIONAL path (relative to the output folder) of a child diagram: the box opens it instead of the leaf page (diagram before prose)
_schema_notes.a tier missing from a node's audience ma: still rendered: status missing + placeholder not_available - there is no escape hatch
